sprint.title: One Unambiguous Two-Hop Local Destination Traversal
sprint.goal: Resolve only a uniquely eligible two-hop authored local route for go to <location> and move to <location>, validating both hops before movement and reusing existing immediate movement semantics.
acceptance_criteria: go to <location> and move to <location> may traverse exactly one uniquely eligible two-hop local route, ending at the canonical destination.
The complete route is validated before any movement mutation; missing or ambiguous routes fail deterministically without movement.
Each accepted hop uses existing immediate local movement semantics, while direct and immediate behavior remains unchanged.
Route resolution is derived, transient, bounded to two hops, and deterministic for cycles and unrelated connections.
Save version remains 1; no persistence architecture, migration, parser expansion, general pathfinding, route ranking, or provider behavior is introduced.

staging_commands: Official-interpreter preflight through the established workspace procedure
focused_commands: Focused two-hop local destination traversal tests
Affected interaction-kernel, movement, navigation-projection, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
Simulation retains authority over structural connectivity and movement; two-hop route resolution is derived and transient.
The interaction kernel may resolve only one unambiguous route with exactly one intermediate location and must validate the entire route before movement.
Do not infer or execute general pathfinding, route ranking, destination knowledge, persistence changes, or excluded systems. Save version remains 1.
Provider requests are forbidden for automated verification, and next_sprint remains null.
